[[Ancient Armor Remnants]] can be used to change a single [[hero]]'s armor set to a hero version of [[Ancient armor]]. To change a hero's armor, speak to [[Johe]] in [[Remains of Sahlahja (outpost)|Remains of Sahlahja]] while that hero is in your party.

Only [[Nightfall]] [[hero]]es who do not have [[Mysterious armor]] or [[Elite Sunspear armor]] available to them are eligible for this armor:

*[[Margrid the Sly]]
*[[Master of Whispers]]
*[[Razah]]
*[[Tahlkora]]
*[[Zhed Shadowhoof]]

==Acquisition==
*[[The Desolation]]
**[[Remains of Sahlahja]]
***[[Maddened Spirit]]
:::<small>''Item has a very small chance to be placed directly in each player's inventory each time one of these creatures are killed.''</small>

== Notes ==
* Ancient Armor Remnants used to drop from the Lost Souls in the same zone as the Maddened Spirits, but no longer.
* Once a hero has been given at least one alternate set of armor, you can switch between any of their unlocked sets at any [[hero armorer]]s corresponding to that hero.
